description: Use this first whenever someone asks for a contractor, a quote or an estimate visit for a home in a Massachusetts town. Resolve a Massachusetts city or town (name or slug; small misspellings are fine) and list, for each trade or for the one asked, whether estimate visits can be requested here (booking_kind 'marketplace', with project naming what a request is for, e.g. 'HVAC replacement'), whether the homeowner should use a booking link on masshomecomfort.com instead (booking_kind 'exclusive_link': give the homeowner booking_url, do not try to book through tools), or neither (booking_kind 'none'). Each trade comes with its page URL. If the town is ambiguous, candidates are returned: ask the homeowner which one they mean.

town.description: The Massachusetts city or town, e.g. 'Worcester' or 'north-andover'.

trade.description: Optional trade, by name or slug (e.g. 'HVAC', 'roofing', 'windows-doors'). Leave it out to see every trade.

name: get_coverage
title: Check a Massachusetts town
